content: María, gwallu-wawagwadgi Jesús-magsad
Ibanergwase (6), Oburgwilegoenad-Iba-naguoele, Jesús Betania-neggweburse Lázaro-maidse nonikid. Jesús, we-Lázaro-burgwisgusgu, gannar odulos gusadid.
Agine, Jesúsʼga sedo masgunned imaksamalad. Deunni, Marta ega mas-daknai gusad. Lázaroʼdi, Jesús-mas-gunsigu, sii gusmogad.

Agi María, bute-wargwen gwallu-wawad-nued-nardoʼye-nugad, ber gargesailadi, Jesúsʼse senonikid. Geb degi, María Jesús-naggi a-gwallu-wawagwad eosad. Geb e-sailagiagi Jesús-nag odinnosad. Gwallu-wawagwad-e-yapanned bela neg-gasa sigisad.
Jesús-sapin-wargwen, Simón-machi-Judas-Iscarioteʼye-nugad, Jesús-darba-ukoed-dule, sokalid:
—¿Ibiga we-gwallu-wawagwad mani-birgagwen-amilege-wilubyobi, uklessuli? Adi, a-mani wileganaga uklegoenad.
Ar Judas degisogsadi, dule-wilegana-sabedbali, deyob sogsasulid. Ar ade, dule-atursilid. Ar mani-sagu-sedidasoggu, agi mani-urbilemaid gusgu arbak atursadii daed.
Geb degi, Jesús, Judas-abin sogded: —Mer Maríaʼga akar-soge. We gwallu-wawadgi-an-magsadi, an-diglegoed-ular, an-magsad.
Ar bemar-abargi wileganadi gusgu gudiguoed. Andi bemar-abargi sadeguosulid.
Judío-dummagan, Lázaro-oburgwebi gusmalad
Judíoʼmar-bukidar Jesús Betaniaʼgi-gudiiye wisguarmargu, ese duurmaknonimalad. Unnila Jesús-dakegarbi nonisurmalad. Lázaro-dakega nonimarbalid. Ar ade, Jesús, Lázaro-burgwar-mai odulosad.
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan deyob itosmargu, igar amismalad, Lázaro-oburgwemarmogoye.
Ar ade, Lázaro-durgusadba, Judíoʼmar-bukidar Judío-igar-odurdakmaladgi bangudmalad, Jesúsʼgi-bensuli gunonimalad.
Jesús, Jerusalén-neggweburgi reyyob dogsad
A-banedgine, dule-bukidar-ibase-nonimalad itoarmargu, Jesús Jerusalénʼse daniye,
ogob-gagangiid-e-gagan gwachamalad. Degine, Jesús-nug-odummogega Jesús-abin nadmalad. Jesús-dakarmargu, binnasur gotemalad, sogdemalad:

content.text: We-dule, Bab-Dummad-nuggi danikid, bela ega ibnuedga gusun.

content: Salmo 118:26
Jesús moli-uayasuid-e-mimmi amisad. Geb e-birgi sigisad, ar igi Bab-Dummad-gardagi narmakar-sognaiyob:

content.text: Be dake, be-Rey, moli-uayasuid-e-mimmi-birgi-sii bese danikid.”

content: Zacarías 9:9

Ar Jesús-sapingan gebesailagi aku-itosmalad, wede ibi-obare. Ar Jesús-nug Bab-Dummadse-ogannolesad-sorbali, geb e-sapingan insadmalad, Bab-Dummad-gardagi we-Jesúsʼgi bato degi-narmakar-naidba ega imaklesa.
Dulemar-Jesúsʼba-gudigusmaladi, Jesús Lázaro-neg-uan-yaba-maigu-ese-gochad-daksamaladi, degi, gannar-odulosad-daksamarbalidi, dule-baiganga a-ibmar-gusad sogedbimalad.
A-ulale, dulemar-bukidar Jesús-abin nonigusmalad. Ar ade, itosmalad, igi Lázaro gannar odulolesgusa.
Ar Fariseoʼmardi muchub-muchub sokarmalad: “Anmar, dulemar-mer-Jesúsʼba-naguegala, geg oakaloged. Be dake, ar bela dulemar eba duurmakmaid.”
Griego-dulemar, Jesús-aminonimalad
Griego-dulemarmoga, Judíoʼmar-ibagi Bab-Dummadse-golega, Judíoʼmar-abargi nonimarmogad.
Amar, Felipeʼse nonimalad. Felipeʼde, Galilea-yargi-Betsaida-neggweburginedid. Griego-dulemar Felipeʼgi wilenaigusmalad, ega sogdemalad: —Dummad, anmar Jesús-dakbimalad.
Felipe nadgu, Andrésʼga sogdapid. Degine, Felipe, Andrés-ebogwa Jesúsʼga sogdapmarsunnad.
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Emigindi, ani Dule-Machi, an-nug-odummolegega iba nagunonisun.
Napira an bemarga soged, ar ibmar-gwag napagi argwansulile, e-uka nungusulile, geg ainied. Ar napagi-argwanerdi, degi, e-uka-nunguerdi, ainidagogu, bukidar sanmakodo.
”Ar amba deyobmodo. Dule e-san-burba-sabele, binsa sabguodo. Ar we-napneggi e-san-burba na sabsulirdi, burba-geg-bergued nikuoed.
Ar dule anga arbabiele, an-sogedba-nanaega anba dagodo. Dule-anga-arbaedi, an-gudiguoedgine gudii gumogoed. Ar dule anga arbaele, an-Bab a-dule-nug odummomogoed.”
Jesús, e-burgoedgi sunmaksad

Jesús sogdebar: “Emigindi, ulubgi an surbinsa itoged. Degi-an-itogedba, ¿an sogoe, ‘Bab-Dummad, emigindi we-ibmar-nunmaked-dummad be anga osuloye?’ Suli, degi-an-sogosuli. Ar burgwega an we-napnegse nonikid.
Bur an sogodo: Bab-Dummad, be-nug be odummoge.” Degidgine, nibneggi gayaburba gornonikid: “An-nug bato an ogannosad. An-nug gannar an ogannobaloed.”
Dule-bukmalad, gayaburba-sunmak-itosmaladi, sogdemalad: “Mar gocha.” Baigandi sogmalad: “Baliwitur-wargwen ega sunmaksa.”
Jesús sunmakdegu, sogded: —We-gayaburba-be-itosmaladi, anga nonisulid, bemarga nonikid.
Emigindi, we-napneggi-dule-bukmalad-sabsur-odurdakleged-iba nagunonikid. Emigindi, nia-saila we-napneg-dummadga-gudiid-onoleged-iba nonisunnad.
Ar napagi-onakwiles an nagusale, bela dulemar anba nagumalaga an ebioed.
Jesús weyob sogsagusadi, mag-ito imaknaid, ede nakrusgi bioklegar burgoye.

Dulemar, Jesús-abin sogdemalad: —Anmar wismalad Moisés-igargi sognaid, ‘Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-dule-Cristo nonikile, burgosulid, degisadeguoed.’ ¿Ar ibiga bedi sogsunna, Dule-Machi nakrusgi bioklegar onakwilegergebye? Ar Dule-Machi, ¿we doasunna?

Geb degi, Jesús, abin-sogded: —Emigindi, ani gwallu-meegwadga ichesaar amba bemar-abargi an gudiid. Gwallu-meegwad amba bemar-abargi-gudiidgi eba be nanamar, adi, melle negsichid ukiarmakar begi nonimalagar. Ar dule negsichidgi-nadapile, wissurdaed, bia nadapi.
Emigindi, amba be gwallu-meegwad-nikmarsoggu, gwallugi mer be bengumar, adi, bemar neg-meegwad-mimmiganga gumalagar. Jesús degi-ibmar-sogsagusad-sorba nadsunnad. Mer e-amimalaga emar-idu dukusad.
Judío-dummagan, Jesús-abingassurmalad
Ar Jesús emar-wagab ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisurmalad-bukidar imaksa-inigwele, dulemar amba Jesúsʼgi bengusmalad.
Ar epenne Bab-gayaburba-barsoged-Isaías-sogsagusadyob-guegala, deyob gunonikid, deun sogsagusgu:
Isaías 53:1
A-ulale, dulemar Jesús-abingassurmalad. Ar ade, Isaías amba sogsagusbalid:

content.text: adi, melle na e-ibyagi mag dakmalagar,
Ar degiile, amar an nudake dakledago-itole.”

content: Isaías 6:10
Deunni, Isaías Jesús-e-gangued-daksagu, weyob sogsagusad. Degi, egi sunmaksa gusad.

Degi-inigwele, bukidar dummagan-neg-dakmamaid, ulubgi Jesúsʼgi-bensuli gusmalad. Ar we-dummagan Fariseoʼmar Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggi e-onomaloed-dobedbali bakar-buud gwen sogsasurmalad, emarde, Jesúsʼba naimoye.
Deginbali, ar dummagan, dulemar-ei-nug-odummoged bur abeged. Ar Bab-Dummad-ei-nug-odummogeddi, abesurmalad.
Jesús-ibmar-sogsad, dulemargi gwisguoed
Jesús binnasur sunmakde, sogded: “Ar dule an-bensulile, anbi an-bengusuli gusulid, Bab-Dummad-an-barmialid bensurbalid.
Ar dule mag an-dakale an-doa-dule, dule-an-barmialid mag-dakbardo.
Ani, we-napnegse gwallu-meegwadga, an nonikid. Adi, bela-angi-bensurmalad, mer bar negsichidgi-gudii gumalagar.
”Ar dule an-gayaburba-itogedba dasulile, ani an sogosulid, be dummad-nosye. An we-napnegse nonisulid, dulemarga sogega be nue-isgusmarye. An dulemar-abonogegala nonikid.

Ar dule an-abingasulile, degine, an-gayaburba-sunmaked abingasurbalile, e-sabsur-odurdakoed bato nikad. Ibagan-berguoedgi an-ibmar-sogsadba dulemar-an-abingassurmalad Bab-Dummadse sabsur-odurdaklegoed.
”An-itolegedba an ibmar sogsasulid. Bab-Dummad an-barmialid, a, igar anga uksad, igi an sogoe, degi, igi an sunmakbaloe.
An wisdo, an-Bab-igar-anga-uksadi, dulemar-anba-nagumaloedga burba-geg-bergued uked. Degisoggu, an ibmar-sogedi, ar igi Bab-Dummad anga sogsa, deyob an soged.”
